findings.issue_summary: App requests precise location (ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION) for concert search when features only require approximate location (coarse city-level access).
findings.evidence: AndroidManifest.xml Line 15 requests ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION and LocationManager.kt Line 19 uses Priority.PRIORITY_HIGH_ACCURACY, despite MainViewModel+Concerts.kt Line 37 using location solely to search concerts within a 50-mile radius (range=50mi).
findings.recommendation: Downgrade Manifest to ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION to respect the minimum scope mandate.

findings.issue_summary: App purpose (Mave) does not inherently imply location tracking, yet foreground location access is performed without a prominent disclosure.
findings.evidence: LocationManager.kt Line 18 retrieves device location via FusedLocationProviderClient for concert discovery without executing an in-app prominent disclosure dialog explaining location data collection.
findings.recommendation: Implement a Prominent In-App Disclosure dialog explaining what location data is collected before requesting foreground permission.

findings.issue_summary: Precise location (ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION) is requested on Android 14+ (Target SDK 37).
findings.evidence: AndroidManifest.xml Line 15 and LocationManager.kt Line 19 request precise location access on Target SDK 37.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to the Location Button API as the minimum scope mechanism for precise foreground location.

findings.issue_summary: Foreground services are declared targeting SDK 37, requiring a Play Console Foreground Service declaration.
findings.evidence: AndroidManifest.xml Lines 40-52 declare foreground services WearableStreamingService (types camera|microphone|mediaPlayback) and PlaybackService (type mediaPlayback) targeting SDK 37.
findings.recommendation: For apps targeting Android 14+, you must complete a Foreground Service declaration in the Play Console (App content section) for each type used, providing a functional description, user impact video, and a specific use case selection.

findings.issue_summary: App requests broad RECORD_AUDIO permission on Target SDK 37 for user-initiated vocal input and recording.
findings.evidence: AndroidManifest.xml Line 13 declares RECORD_AUDIO and MainActivity.kt Line 278 requests RECORD_AUDIO runtime permission for occasional user-initiated voice commands triggered via chat-interface.ts Line 38 on Target SDK 37.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to the Android Microphone Button API to process temporary audio securely.
